blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The license of a driver who was heard making an inappropriate remark about a road incident was revoked by the Land Transportation Office (LTO) for violating the Anti-Distracted Driving Act. The LTO said the driver violated traffic laws by using a cellphone while driving to record the incident. “[He] deliberately slow[ed] down amid heavy traffic to record the incident while driving,” it said. The video showed the driver saying, “Sayang naman, hindi pa namatay (What a waste, he didn’t even die),” referring to the incident being attended to by law enforcers.
